create_triton_attn_backend: create a TritonAttnBackend instance for triton-based attention with sliding window and deterministic inference support
build_forward_metadata: build ForwardMetadata containing kv_indptr, kv_indices, attn_logits, and sliding window buffers for a forward batch
run_forward_extend: run extend attention forward pass with qkv tensors, causal masking, and kv cache storage for a RadixAttention layer
run_forward_decode: run decode attention forward pass with kv cache retrieval, kv splits, and logit soft capping for a RadixAttention layer
init_cuda_graph_state: init cuda graph state buffers for attn_logits, attn_lse, kv_indices, and sliding window buffers with fixed max sizes
